findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 11 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 81 questions numbered 1-81; by section: 11.1 3, 11.2 15, 11.3 4, 11.4 4, 11.5 8, 11.6 7, 11.7 12, 11.8 13, 11.9 3, 11.10 7, 11.11 5.

Covers sections 11.1-11.11 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small formula counts were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise (its definitions, differences and naming items are avoided). Book corrections followed: heptane C₇H₁₆, tert-butyl = 1,1-dimethylethyl, cyclopentane C₅H₁₀, Br⁻ as nucleophile, 2-bromoethanol + HBr in halohydration, metamers ethoxyethane/methoxypropane, balanced combustion of ethane giving water, ethene as the ripening hormone.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
